lines.en: Patrol's moving. Keep up or be left behind.

lines.zh: 这条路通向村庄，我闻到了。
lines.en: This road leads to a village. I can smell it.
Crossbow strung. Walk soft, all of you.
Boots through the snow, straight north.
Captain's in front. Hold that banner higher.
Go around that branch, you idiot.
March by night, raid by daylight.
The villagers left their lamps on. Good.

lines.zh: 我数着步子，一步一根箭。
lines.en: I count my steps, one bolt per step.
Hoofprints in the mud. Follow them.
Go around the iron golem. Don't be a fool.
I've walked this trail ten times before.
This crossbow's stiff. Needs oil.
Wind's wrong. The bolt will drift.
My stomach growls. Eat after the looting.
Who left their bolt pouch behind?
I hate the sound of village bells.
Three notches on my crossbow stock.
Cold day. The trigger bites my fingers.
That banner's gone pale. Ugly thing.
Nobody in this patrol can count.
Wait for dark. Wait for the horn.

lines.zh: 你站在路中间，胆子不小。
lines.en: Standing in the road. You've got nerve.
Nice boots. Take them off.
You side with the villagers? Speak.
Hold still. Let me see your pockets.
Another hero passing through, hm.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁傀儡的味道。
lines.en: You smell of iron golem.
Look up. Let me see your face.
Your hands are shaking. I noticed.
This ground belongs to the patrol.
You came to hand something over. Right?
Hss. Who shot me?
Nearly dropped my crossbow.
This little wound? Two steps and it's fine.
Armor caught some of it. Not all.
Back off. Let me catch my breath.
The arrowhead snapped off inside.

lines.zh: 我倒了，后面还有三百个。
lines.en: I fall, and three hundred more are behind me.
The captain will remember this for me.
Legs going weak. Hold steady.
It stings, but my aim's still steady.
Put the carrot away, you fool.
I don't eat what you hand me.
Bribe me? Start with your crossbow.
Keep your food. You'll need it more.
Illagers take no gifts.

lines.zh: 你以为我和猪一样好骗？
lines.en: You think I'm as easy as a pig?
Away with it, or I shoot it through.
That's not enough to buy a life.
I only want the village chests.
Stop waving that sack around. Annoying.
Bump me again and lose a tooth.
Move. I'm carrying a crossbow.
Shoulder to shoulder? Want a fight?
Stop shoving. We queue into the village.
You stepped on my boot, idiot.
One more push and the bolt goes in.
Narrow road. You back up first.
Who bumped me? Step forward.
I don't step aside for anyone.
Hug the wall. Don't touch my crossbow.
No time. We raid at dawn.
Illagers don't bother with such things.
A banner is more reliable than a mate.

lines.zh: 等这次袭击分完赃再说。
lines.en: Ask me after we split the raid loot.
My crossbow is company enough.
Find someone else. I'm on night watch.
When the horn sounds, everything stops.
Fill the bolt pouch first, then talk.
The patrol doesn't discuss private matters.
Don't block my view of the crossing.
This bolt's still good. I'll take it.
What falls on the road goes to whoever's first.
A pouch of iron bits. Good for repairs.
Hands off. This one belongs to the patrol.
This bread? I'll take it, barely.
Someone dropped an emerald. Mine now.
The fletching's snapped. Toss it back.
Into the pocket. Say nothing.
The captain takes half if he sees.
Pick it up. Into the bolt pouch.

lines.zh: 看见那扇木门了，就那儿。
lines.en: See that wooden door? That's the one.
Villagers are running. After them.

lines.zh: 铁傀儡出来了，换穿甲箭。
lines.en: Iron golem's out. Switch to piercing bolts.
Target confirmed. Raise the crossbow.
The one with the sword. Him first.
Someone's ringing the bell. Move faster.
Grab the one in the long robe.
I saw a face behind that window.
This house. The door's unlocked.
Ignore the sheep. Find the people.
He's heading up the tower. Block the stairs.
Locked. Twenty paces, wind to the left.

lines.zh: 就是那个戴草帽的农夫。
lines.en: That's the farmer in the straw hat.
Take him alive. He opens the chests.

lines.zh: 那面旗子倒了，从这里开始。
lines.en: That banner fell. We start here.
Breathe quietly. I'm aiming at your chest.
One more step and the bolt flies.
Hands up. Nice and slow now.
I count to three. Still standing there?

lines.zh: 别躲柱子后面，我算得到。
lines.en: Don't hide behind the post. I can do the math.

lines.zh: 你听得见上弦的声音吧？
lines.en: You hear the winch winding, don't you?
Stand still, or I put a bolt in your leg.
Run, then. It's more fun when you run.
Best shot in the patrol, that's me.
Skip the shield. It won't stop two bolts.
You're shaking. So is my sight.
Back to the corner. Don't make me.
Deep breath. Your last one.

lines.zh: 我看见你手往背后摸了。
lines.en: I saw your hand reach behind you.
I rest my crossbow on the windowsill.

lines.zh: 你从左边绕，我早就架好了。
lines.en: You go around the left. I set up long ago.
Do not look elsewhere. I am right here.
You count my bolts. I count you.
Thwip. That one landed clean.
Wind it back. One more shot.
That one went through your armor.

lines.zh: 别急着倒下，我还没射够。
lines.en: Don't fall yet. I'm not done shooting.
A bolt in the knee stops the running.
This bolt is for the captain.
Blood on the stock. Bad luck.
Fall back. I'm changing pouches.
You block one, not three.
Shooting from behind is easiest.
Bolt's stuck in bone. What a nuisance.
Remember my face before you drop.
One more bolt, to be certain.
Fetch my bolt back. Don't waste it.

lines.zh: 这一箭钉在门框上，差半寸。
lines.en: This bolt sticks in the doorframe, half a foot off.

lines.zh: 我换了个角度，射你的脚。
lines.en: I change my angle and shoot at your feet.
Patrol, form up. Sound off.
Who's got the banner? Raise it.
Walked in from the snowfield. Legs are numb.

lines.zh: 这一带没有铁傀儡，运气好。
lines.en: No iron golem here. Lucky us.
New here? Do you know how to string that?
The captain gave us three days.

lines.zh: 天没亮就出发，谁迟到了？
lines.en: We left before dawn. Who was late?

lines.zh: 闻到烟味了，前面有村子。
lines.en: Smell that smoke? Village ahead.
Fill your pouches. Twenty bolts each.
Quiet now. Get to the wall first.

lines.zh: 我们只是先到的，后面还有。
lines.en: We're just the first. More are coming.

lines.zh: 今晚睡野地，明晚睡村里。
lines.en: Tonight we sleep in a field. Tomorrow, a village.
My bolt pouch is burning. Beat it out!
Fell so hard the crossbow flew.
Water in my boots. So heavy.

lines.zh: 谁点的火药？耳朵嗡嗡响。
lines.en: Who lit the powder? My ears are ringing.

lines.zh: 一根箭插在肩上，还给你。
lines.en: An arrow in my shoulder. Returning it.

lines.zh: 这咒语让我的手指发麻。
lines.en: This spell numbs my fingers.
Two days without looting a meal.
Lightning struck. My crossbow's scorched.
No ground under me. Only black.
